sql: SELECT 'A_deploys_open' AS what, d.deployment_key||' ['||d.kind||']' AS k, COALESCE(string_agg(da.strategy_tag,','),'-') AS v FROM experiment_deployments d LEFT JOIN experiment_deployment_arms da ON da.deployment_id=d.id WHERE d.ended_at IS NULL AND d.deployment_key LIKE 'mmsell-contestcap%' GROUP BY 1,2 UNION ALL SELECT 'B_twin_epoch_open', twin_tag||' <- '||live_tag, to_char(started_at,'MM-DD HH24:MI') FROM live_paper_twins WHERE ended_at IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT 'C_orders_since_boot', COALESCE(status,'?'), count(*)::text FROM live_orders WHERE strategy='Fmmsell10' AND created_at > timestamptz '2026-09-08 07:20:40+00' GROUP BY 1,2 UNION ALL SELECT 'D_funnel_since_boot', to_char(created_at,'HH24:MI'), 'F='||COALESCE((raw_json->'per_book'->>'Fmmsell10'),'0')||' opened='||COALESCE(raw_json->>'opened','?')||' ccap='||COALESCE(raw_json->>'skipped_contest_cap','?') FROM system_events WHERE component='mmsell_scan' AND created_at > timestamptz '2026-09-08 07:20:40+00' UNION ALL SELECT 'E_realized_0908', strategy, to_char(COALESCE(SUM(pnl),0),'FM990.0000')||' n='||count(*)::text FROM paper_trades WHERE strategy IN ('Fmmsell10','Fmmsell10_pt4') AND closed_at >= timestamptz '2026-09-08 00:00:00+00' GROUP BY 1,2 UNION ALL SELECT 'F_open_pos', strategy, count(*)::text FROM paper_trades WHERE strategy IN ('Fmmsell10','Fmmsell10_pt4') AND closed_at IS NULL GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2
